name: secret-scanning
description: Secret-leak prevention: a PreToolUse hook blocks a Write/Edit, or a Bash heredoc/echo written to a file, introducing a high-confidence secret (cloud keys, private-key blocks, provider tokens, assigned secret literals) before it reaches disk; /secret-scanning:scan sweeps a path or diff. A PostToolUse hook names a secret in any tool's output by label, never the value; output is no longer masked, so Code Mode can start. A hooks module (CLI 2.1.291 or newer) masks a secret typed, pasted, @-mentioned or attached into the prompt. Fail-open, with a fixture escape and CC_SECRET_SCAN=off. unicode-scan warns on invisible and bidi characters in text just written or read.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_secret_scan.title: Secret guard (CC_SECRET_SCAN)
cc_secret_scan.description: Refuse a write or shell command that puts a high-confidence secret on disk: on or off. The environment variable CC_SECRET_SCAN overrides this.

cc_secret_commit_scan.title: Commit and push secret scan (CC_SECRET_COMMIT_SCAN)
cc_secret_commit_scan.description: Refuse a git commit or push whose added lines hold a high-confidence secret: on or off. The environment variable CC_SECRET_COMMIT_SCAN overrides this.

cc_unicode_scan.title: Invisible-character scan (CC_UNICODE_SCAN)
cc_unicode_scan.description: Warn when written or read text carries zero-width or bidirectional-override characters: on or off. The environment variable CC_UNICODE_SCAN overrides this.

cc_secret_output_scan.title: Tool-output secret flag (CC_SECRET_OUTPUT_SCAN)
cc_secret_output_scan.description: Name, by its label and never its value, a secret found in a tool's output, after the call: on or off. The environment variable CC_SECRET_OUTPUT_SCAN overrides this.

cc_secret_prompt.title: Prompt-box secret guard (CC_SECRET_PROMPT)
cc_secret_prompt.description: Mark a secret typed or pasted into the prompt box and ask before sending it (mask, send as typed, or cancel); keep out an @-mentioned file holding one, mask one in an attached file, and refuse a write of the [REDACTED:…] marker: on or off. The environment variable CC_SECRET_PROMPT overrides this.
